scenicChapters.title: Jura Crest Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 71 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

legend-olympic-peninsula-loop.story: A coastal forest loop based around Olympia, Washington, via Port Angeles. Key character: temperate rainforest; coast; mountains. Surface: paved.

scenicChapters.title: Olympic Peninsula Loop
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 17 km this is Olympic Peninsula Loop, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
